methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: provides the rational basis for the selection of the best auto-id system with logistics system energy consumption taken into account

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes a multi-criteria 'utilitarian value of information' method for selecting auto-id (barcode/RFID/biometric) systems in logistics; ISO 50001 and system energy consumption are cited only as selection considerations, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised (variables/functional form of the model are for information utility, not energy).

paper_type.evidence_quote: A new approach to auto-id system evaluation is proposed

stage1.notes: ISO 50001 invoked as an evaluation/framing tool and warehouse energy figures reported, but the proposed model quantifies the 'utilitarian value of information' (weighted MCDM), not energy performance; no EnPI/EnB model characterised. paper_type borderline vs 'single applied case' (illustrative press-distribution example, Sect. 3).
